method: Grouped built-in image_gen sheets, then separate RGBA export onto exact original canvases

assets.prompt:
Create ONE transparent 2D game furniture sprite sheet with EXACTLY TWO isolated EMPTY furniture assets, arranged in TWO ROWS (one asset each), no text or labels. Reference1 is the approved front-counter layout (ignore all red annotation strokes and all characters/objects). Reference2 is the original ingredient-table design and warm wood color (ignore red annotation and items on it). Keep soft cute hand-painted orthographic cartoon style, thick warm dark brown contours and warm medium walnut/chestnut wood, NOT pink or gray wood, not bright orange. Same fixed elevated frontal camera; parallel horizontal and vertical edges, NO isometric rotation, NO perspective convergence. Genuine transparent alpha exterior, generous clear separation. Complete silhouettes, no shadows/glows outside furniture.
TOP ROW asset: a substantial EMPTY ingredient preparation table matching reference2. Width to total height ratio about 2.2:1 (NOT a thin long bench). Broad deep rectangular warm medium-brown wood tabletop with round corners, thick front apron and short sturdy legs visible under the front edge. Tabletop plain and clear, no pearl jar, no tea can, no milk bottle, no tools. Show meaningful tabletop depth and robust front body. Warm neutral brown matching reference2 rather than desaturated red/pink.
BOTTOM ROW asset: ONE connected STEPPED L-SHAPED tea shop service counter matching the RED OUTLINED furniture silhouette in reference1. This is NOT a straight narrow bar and NOT a U with two side wings. Its LEFT 43% is a DEEP rectangular work block for a lemonade machine and muddling tools; its RIGHT 57% is a SHALLOW horizontal checkout bar extending to the right. The entire CUSTOMER-FACING FRONT EDGE is one continuous horizontal line. The REAR EDGE steps inward/downward by about half the left-block depth at x=43%, leaving a clear recessed staff space BEHIND the right bar. Think union of two rectangles in the TOP SURFACE: left rectangle [0,0] to[43%,70%height], right rectangle[43%,35%height] to[100%,70%height]. Below this top surface, a thick rounded brown front apron and dark blue gray recessed plinth run across the FULL front width. The left return/back section is visibly twice as deep as the right bar. All plan edges perfectly horizontal/vertical in orthographic projection, no angled wing or receding diagonal. Overall complete counter visible width:height about3.6:1 (not5:1). Draw it wide enough to fill most of sheet width. EMPTY tabletop everywhere: no machine, cash register, cup, ice bin, spoon, pestle, shelf, person, food, glass divider, separate small table or lettering. A single integrated wooden L/stepped counter with a continuous front and rear inner step.
High-resolution refined crisp isolated game sprites. Both assets independent on one sheet; no scene, no backgrounds, no numbers, no red marks.

Create ONE production-ready TRANSPARENT game sprite sheet with exactly FOUR separated sprites in a strict 2 columns by 2 rows layout. Equal cells, generous clear transparent gutters, no text, no dividers or labels. Reference image1 (full tea shop) is the authoritative SHAPE, PALETTE and arrangement reference. Images2 and3 show existing pot and milk mixer appearance to preserve/refine. User says the support under the brewing pot is an INTEGRATED POWERED INDUCTION WORK CABINET, NOT a generic wooden table, and a pipe connects the rear of the pot and the mixer. Correct these specific structures.
TOP LEFT cell: ONE complete wide powered induction brewing work cabinet, empty top surface, NO pot or mixer on it. Chunky rounded warm cream/beige top platform with substantial visible depth, solid cream/taupe cabinet or heating plinth body beneath rather than a thin shelf, short low dark feet. A narrow integrated dark charcoal electrical control column on its LEFT side with two small red/green round power lights, darker power housing and a little visible power cable tucked against the cabinet. Match the compact workstation proportions in image1: overall visible width to height around 2.5:1. NO four long wooden table legs, NO thin narrow bench, NO orange timber top, NO stainless laboratory cart. It supports TWO appliances side by side.
TOP RIGHT cell: ONE round open cream tea BREWING POT matching image1: thick soft silver rim, amber tea with a few brown tea pieces, dark warm brown handles at sides. It sits directly flat on the heating cabinet. Complete pot silhouette, NO tall appliance body, NO separate pedestal, NO electrical control block stuck to the side (that belongs to the cabinet), NO attached pipe, NO furniture. Front slightly lower than mixer in scene.
BOTTOM LEFT cell: ONE tall rounded cream automatic MILK MIXER matching image1 and image3: charcoal panel with three amber vertical indicator bars, dark round button to right, small nozzle below, dark low drip tray/foot. No cup, no table, no attached pipe. Compact cute dimensions and soft highlights, not shiny realistic plastic.
BOTTOM RIGHT cell: ONE independent rigid dark gray-purple CONNECTOR PIPE matching image1: left end is a short vertical downward open stub, upper-left rounded ninety-degree elbow bends into a LONG straight horizontal upper run that continues RIGHT to a short horizontal open stub. Thus an inverted L shape with a rounded top-left elbow (not a U and not an arch). Pipe cross-section thick enough to see in game, dark brown outlines, gray plum body, soft narrow pale highlight, no hose coils, no valves, no machines attached. This sprite will draw behind both machines connecting pot rear-left up then across toward milk mixer rear.
All four sprites share identical orthographic elevated front camera, parallel rectangular sides with no perspective convergence or isometric diamond, soft cute hand-painted tea shop cartoon style, dark warm brown crisp rounded outlines, MUTED soft palette faithful to image1 with cream, taupe and charcoal-plum (avoid overly bright orange or saturated glossy colors). Clean refined details. Whole complete objects, never crop. Exterior/gutters genuinely transparent alpha, no floor, wall, glow, vignette, checkerboard, words, characters, cups, shadows extending outside. Four independent complete objects only. Landscape or square high-resolution sheet; no composited example scene.
